top_choice_rationale: Base editing is the best-defined and most mature achievement on the slate: a deaminase positioned by a nickase converts one base without a double-strand break, and the adenine editor needed a deaminase evolved to act on DNA. It is quantitative, widely replicated and in patients. As a single-achievement prize the three-seat cap no longer forces the exclusion of Komor and Gaudelli, whose two papers are the decisive demonstrations of the cytidine and adenine editors, with Liu as originator of the programme. A Liu-only credit in the two-part slates understates them, and the PROTAC, dye-sensitized cell and C-N coupling pairings are either earlier, less thematically tied or closer to extensions of earlier prizes. P001 follows because it keeps base editing and adds a mechanistically clean degradation concept, despite the Liu-only cost.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai are on the committee but this is not a conflict with any laureate on the slate
